source_fingerprint.algorithm: sha256(path + NUL + file bytes + NUL, sorted source paths)
source_fingerprint.scope: Cargo.toml/lock, src, crates, assets, os scripts/helpers/config/systemd/tests; no generated evidence/docs/builds

scope: Regular-file authenticated package/capsule staging and diskless fixture guard only; no installed root grant, target install or hardware clearance
pool_scope: The earlier v4 pool was built at its own retained recipe/source checkpoint. The current capsule independently reconstructs its catalogue from original signed indexes and rechecks every archive.
synthetic_scope: Unit CPIO/kernel/module inputs are private synthetic fixtures only. Actual staging and guest use the qualified Debian backend and the pinned native module.
